title: Unified energy system model configuration (revision 2, converged with the meme Go implementation)
description: Revision of unified_schema.json converged with meme's Go canonical model (internal/model: Job = Model + Experiment). Every divergence between the first-revision schema and the Go implementation was resolved by taking the better of the two designs; the decision log is docs/unified_schema_vs_go.md. Adopted from the GO IMPLEMENTATION: the Job document shape separating the physical `model` from the run-spec `experiment`; Go's JSON field names throughout (transmission, trade, emission_limits, bound, distance, max_pu, role, coords, ...), so the schema validates meme REST payloads directly; indexed parameters ({data, index, dims}) in $defs/Value; the Performance IR (constant | piecewise | physics with precomputed fallback); multi-class cost maps keyed by cost class ('monetary' is the class every emitter reads); explicit multi-port `flows` with direction and reference marking; the six-value run mode enum; dotted-path scenario overrides shared with `sweep`; and the implemented validation rules (storage role needs a storage block, demand role needs a demand_profile, flows need an input and at most one reference, referential integrity is checked by the Go side). Adopted from the FIRST-REVISION SCHEMA (now implemented in Go; "x-go" names the field): structured per-mode options (operate/alternatives/pareto/monte_carlo) instead of burying them in solver options; first-class solver time_limit/mip_gap/threads; richer capacity (systemwide bounds, unit counts, decommissioning); storage extras (power-energy-ratio mode, charge/discharge rate bounds, depth of discharge, async switch); transmission extras (per-distance loss/cost, min flow, auxiliary energy, emission factor); trade extras (series-valued limits, export emission factor, native block); reporting; emission accounting choice; unmet-demand/copperplate switches; rich investment periods; inline per-timestep arrays and non-finite literals in $defs/Value; and document-level native blocks that VALIDATE against the three untouched source schemas (adopt_net0_schema.json, pypsa_schema.json, calliope_schema.json). Annotations: every property carries "x-go" (the Go field it maps to, or null for a proposed extension) and, where useful, "x-map" (the native counterpart per framework; null = emulated or unsupported, see the source schemas' x-maps for detail). Canonical units: power MW, energy MWh, cost in metadata.currency, emissions t CO2-eq, distance km, time hours, fractions 0..1, timestamps ISO 8601.

api_key.description: Transport-level authentication (checked when the server has API_KEY configured, ignored otherwise); redacted from the config.json persisted into the result bundle.

model.description: The physical system: time domain, carriers, nodes, technologies, transmission, market trade, and system-wide limits.

experiment.description: The run specification: everything about HOW to solve. Omitted = a plan-mode min-cost run with the default solver.

NonFiniteNumber.title: Non-finite number literal
NonFiniteNumber.description: String spelling of an IEEE-754 non-finite value (JSON has no Infinity/NaN literals). Canonical: 'inf'/'-inf'/'NaN' (PyPSA convention); the YAML spellings '.inf'/'-.inf'/'.nan' (Calliope convention) are aliases. The Go model expresses 'unbounded' by omitting the field; emitters translate accordingly.

SeriesRef.title: Named time-series reference
SeriesRef.description: Reference to an entry of model.timeseries: the series id, optionally prefixed with 'ts:' (Value.SeriesID strips the prefix). A series named like a $defs/NonFiniteNumber literal must use the 'ts:' prefix.

IndexedParam.title: Indexed parameter
IndexedParam.description: A parameter defined over one or more dimensions (Calliope's {data, index, dims} model): data[i] is the value at coordinate index[i], a tuple over dims. Structural rule (checked by Go Value.StructuralError, not expressible in JSON Schema): len(data) == len(index) and every index tuple has len(dims) coordinates. Example: {"data": [10, 20], "index": [["monetary"], ["co2"]], "dims": ["costs"]}.

x-map.pypsa: reduced to a scalar via Value.Select/Reduce (multi-entry indexed params are rejected for flat targets, model.FirstMultiIndexed)

Value.title: Parameter value
Value.description: A possibly time-varying, possibly dimensioned parameter: a bare number; a time-series id string resolving against model.timeseries; an indexed {data, index, dims} object; an inline per-timestep array (interned into model.timeseries under a reserved "_inline:" id by Model.InternInlineSeries before validation, so emitters see exactly one series shape); or a non-finite literal (Go expresses unbounded by omission).

oneOf.description: Inline per-timestep values aligned with the model time index (interned to a registry series).

Value.x-go: Value (scalar | series ref | inline array | indexed param)

StringList.title: String or list of strings
StringList.description: Accepts a single string or an array of strings (Go StringList).

TimeSeries.title: Time-series registry entry
TimeSeries.description: An inline vector or a reference to a CSV column on disk.

unit.description: Informational unit of the series values.

x-map.adopt-net0: columns of the per-node CSVs (ClimateData.csv, CarbonCost.csv, <carrier>.csv)

NativeBlock.title: Component-level native passthrough
NativeBlock.description: Framework-specific extra configuration for one component, merged verbatim into the emitted output of that framework and ignored for the others. Using a native block target-locks the payload; the Go side surfaces this as a warning (model.NativeWarnings).

pypsa.description: Partial of PyPSA's own input schema (see pypsa_schema.json $defs for component attributes).

calliope.description: Partial of Calliope's own input schema (see calliope_schema.json $defs/techDef, $defs/nodeDef, $defs/config).

adopt-net0.description: Partial of AdOpT-NET0's own input schema (see adopt_net0_schema.json $defs; technology blocks patch technology_data/<name>.json like $defs/MemeOverrides).

NativeModel.title: Model-level native passthrough
NativeModel.description: System-wide native configuration, one block per framework, merged verbatim into that framework's emitted output (PyPSA: the _native.pypsa.json sidecar; Calliope: the model YAML; AdOpT-NET0: the ConfigModel/topology files). Deliberately free-form to mirror the Go side (json.RawMessage) and real payloads, which carry annotation keys; the VOCABULARY each block should follow is the corresponding source schema (pypsa_schema.json, calliope_schema.json, adopt_net0_schema.json), which guarantees that everything expressible in any framework remains expressible here.

pypsa.description: Partial PyPSA network document; vocabulary: pypsa_schema.json.

calliope.description: Partial Calliope model definition; vocabulary: calliope_schema.json.

Model.title: Physical model
Model.description: The physical system. Referential integrity (every node, carrier and series reference resolves; node_overrides name placed nodes) is enforced by the Go side (Model.Validate) and cannot be expressed in JSON Schema.

periods.description: Optional multi-horizon investment periods, in order. Entries are plain names or rich objects carrying the representative year (required by PyPSA multi-horizon), elapsed years, and objective weight. No emitter consumes periods yet.
periods.x-go: Model.Periods []Period (string or rich object; no emitter consumes periods yet)

discount_rate.description: global discount/interest rate (fraction) applied to annualize investment of all components; null = each technology's own interest_rate applies.

carriers.description: Energy/material carriers, keyed by id. Go rejects a model with no carriers.

nodes.description: Spatial nodes, keyed by id. Go rejects a model with no nodes. Which carriers exist at a node is DERIVED from the technologies, transmission and trade placed there (kept non-redundant on purpose).

timeseries.description: Named time-series registry that Value series references resolve against.

technologies.description: Technology definitions, keyed by id. A technology may sit at several nodes; emitters expand it to one instance per node ('<id>@<node>').

transmission.description: Carrier transport between two nodes, keyed by id. Electrical load-flow parameters (impedances, AC power flow) are PyPSA-only and belong in native.pypsa.

trade.description: Per-(node, carrier) import/export against an external market, keyed by id.

emission_limits.description: System-wide caps on an emission species.

constraints.description: Portable linear constraints: sum_i(coefficient_i * variable_i[scope_i]) sense bound. The target-neutral IR for global/share constraints and the linear slice of custom math; nonlinear constraints stay in native.

version.description: User version string of the model itself.

currency.description: Informational currency of all cost figures (no framework converts currencies).

currency_year.description: Reference year of the currency (real vs nominal cost figures).

Time.title: Time domain
Time.description: The snapshot/timestep index. Temporal AGGREGATION (clustering, resampling) is a run concern and lives on experiment.time_aggregation.

resolution.description: Temporal resolution as a pandas frequency alias, e.g. "1H", "3H".

subset.description: [start, end] inclusive sub-range of the horizon actually solved.

timesteps.description: explicit timestep labels for irregular indices; takes precedence over start/end/resolution.
timesteps.x-go: TimeConfig.Timesteps (pypsa snapshots + calliope data tables; rejected by adopt-net0)

weights.description: weight of each timestep in the objective and in energy/emission accounting (hours represented). Default 1.
weights.x-go: TimeConfig.Weights (pypsa snapshot_weightings scalar/series; calliope timestep_weights scalar; rejected by adopt-net0)

year.description: Representative year (PyPSA investment periods must be increasing integer years).

length_years.description: Elapsed years until the subsequent period.

objective_weight.description: Multiplier on this period's cost coefficients in the objective.

Carrier.title: Carrier
Carrier.description: An energy or material vector (electricity, hydrogen, heat, CO2, ...). Kept orthogonal to Node; the PyPSA emitter fuses the two into buses.

unit.description: Informational unit of carrier flows (e.g. MW, t/h).

co2_intensity.description: Embedded emissions of consuming one MWh of this carrier as primary energy (t CO2-eq/MWh).

x-map.adopt-net0: spread onto technology emission factors and trade emission-factor columns
x-map.calliope: emulated via a co2 cost class

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A spatial point. Technologies live at a node and declare their carriers; a node never carries carrier identity itself.

allowed_techs.description: Restriction of which technologies may be placed at this node; omitted = no restriction.

available_area.description: Area budget shared by all area-using technologies at this node (Calliope-gated capability).

climate.description: Weather series for physics-based performance models (AdOpT-NET0 ClimateData columns: ghi, dni, dhi, temp_air, rh, ws10, hydro_inflow); values are scalars or series references.

x-map.pypsa: consumed by the orchestrator to precompute profiles
x-map.calliope: consumed by the orchestrator to precompute profiles

Technology.title: Technology
Technology.description: Any node-local component that produces, consumes, converts, or stores carriers. Validation mirrored from Go (Model.Validate): role 'storage' requires the storage block; role 'demand' requires demand_profile. Cross-field rule not expressible here (Go-checked): with cost_basis 'overnight' (or unset), any investment_per_capacity needs lifetime and interest_rate to annualize.

x-map.pypsa: component selection: generators / links|processes / storage_units|stores / loads

node.description: Node(s) this technology sits at; emitters expand to one instance per node.

efficiency.description: Simple one-in/one-out conversion factor. For multi-input or multi-output conversion use `flows`; when flows is non-empty it takes precedence.

flows.description: Ports of a multi-carrier conversion. Ratios are per unit of the reference input flow (the one marked reference, or the first input). Rules (mirrored from Go): at least one input flow; at most one reference flow.

x-map.pypsa: multi-output Link (bus0 + bus1/efficiency + bus2/efficiency2 + ...) or Process rates

capacity.description: Capacity of the reference flow (MW). For storage this bounds charge/discharge POWER; stored energy is storage.energy_capacity.

demand_profile.description: Exogenous demand time series (MW, positive = consumption). Required when role is 'demand'.

demand_curtailable.description: serving less than demand_profile is allowed (profile becomes an upper bound). System-wide slack is experiment.allow_unmet_demand.

x-map.pypsa: emulated: negative-sign generator with p_max_pu = profile

area.description: Land/area use constraints (Calliope-gated capability; counts against the node's available_area).

max.description: Maximum area this technology may occupy.

per_capacity.description: Area used per unit of installed capacity.

source.description: Resource/source bounds of a supply technology (Calliope-gated capability).

unit.description: Unit basis of the source bound.

max.description: Maximum source use per timestep (scalar or series), in the basis given by unit.

costs.description: Costs per cost class. Emitters read the class "monetary" (model.PrimaryCostClass) to populate the framework's monetary fields; other classes (e.g. "co2") are honored only by targets with multi-class cost support and warned about otherwise.

lifetime.description: Technical/economic lifetime in years (annuitization; PyPSA multi-period retirement).

interest_rate.description: Component discount/interest rate (fraction) for annuitizing overnight investment; model.discount_rate (when set) overrides it globally.

cost_basis.description: Whether investment_per_capacity figures are overnight (annuitized via lifetime + interest_rate) or already annualized.

emission_factor.description: direct emissions per MWh of reference flow (t CO2-eq/MWh); negative for negative-emission technologies. Alternative to carrier-level co2_intensity - use one accounting route consistently.
emission_factor.x-go: Technology.EmissionFactor (adopt-net0 Performance.emission_factor; calliope co2 cost class; rejected by pypsa)

x-map.pypsa: emulated via the fuel carrier's co2_emissions and efficiency
x-map.calliope: emulated via a co2 cost class

annual_output_min.description: minimum total reference output over the weighted horizon (MWh).

annual_output_max.description: maximum total reference output over the weighted horizon (MWh), e.g. resource budgets.

build_year.description: commissioning year of existing capacity (multi-period retirement together with lifetime).

active.x-go: Technology.Active (pypsa/calliope active flag; adopt-net0 omits the tech)

node_overrides.description: Per-node parameter overrides. Keys must be members of `node` (Go-checked). A non-nil override field replaces the base value wholesale; costs merge per cost class (Technology.At).

x-map.pypsa: differing attribute values on the <id>@<node> rows

NodeOverride.title: Per-node technology override
NodeOverride.description: Replaces a subset of a technology's parameters at a specific node. Any absent field leaves the base value unchanged; costs are merged per cost class.

ratio.description: Flow per unit of the reference input flow. Required on every non-reference flow; the reference input flow is its own basis (implicit ratio 1) and omits it.

reference.description: Marks the reference input flow that capacity and ratios refer to (at most one per technology; defaults to the first input).

then.$comment: Non-reference flows must state their ratio; the reference flow may omit it.

Performance.title: Performance model
Performance.description: How a technology converts input to output beyond a single efficiency: a piecewise part-load curve, or a physics-based model. AdOpT-NET0 evaluates these natively; PyPSA and Calliope require a precomputed series (`precomputed`). Piecewise rules mirrored from Go (Performance.Validate): >= 2 breakpoints, loads within [0,1] and strictly increasing (ordering not expressible here), efficiencies > 0.

breakpoints.description: type == piecewise: part-load performance curve (MILP with min stable load).

min_load.description: Minimum stable load, fraction of capacity (piecewise).

model.description: type == physics: the recognized physics model (Go physicsModels). Each maps to an AdOpT-NET0 technology type; other targets need `precomputed`.

x-map.pypsa: precomputed profile (pvlib/wind curve/COP) via the orchestrator

precomputed.description: Series id of a precomputed profile for non-AdOpT targets.

Capacity.title: Capacity specification
Capacity.description: Fixed base (existing), whether size is a decision variable (expandable), and bounds; in `unit` (default MW; MWh for storage energy capacity).

x-map.calliope: flow_cap_min = flow_cap_max = existing when not expandable

expandable.description: Whether the optimizer may build capacity beyond `existing`.

min.description: Lower bound on total installed capacity.

max.description: Upper bound on total installed capacity. Omitted or 'inf' = unbounded; Go expresses unbounded by omission and does not parse the 'inf' literal (a deliberate non-implementation - see the report).

unit.description: Unit of the size variable (e.g. MW, MWh, t/h).

per_unit.description: Modular sizing: capacity of one integer module. Introduces integer variables.

systemwide_min.description: lower bound on this component's capacity summed over all nodes.
systemwide_min.x-go: Capacity.SystemwideMin (calliope flow_cap_min_systemwide; pypsa sidecar constraint; rejected by adopt-net0)

systemwide_max.description: upper bound on this component's capacity summed over all nodes.
systemwide_max.x-go: Capacity.SystemwideMax (calliope flow_cap_max_systemwide; pypsa sidecar constraint; rejected by adopt-net0)

decommission.description: what may happen to `existing` capacity during optimization.

mode.x-go: Decommission.Mode (adopt-net0 native; calliope impossible/continuous; pypsa impossible only)

x-map.pypsa: emulated via p_nom bounds; only_complete needs native
x-map.calliope: emulated via flow_cap_min; only_complete needs custom math

cost.description: Cost per unit of retired capacity.

Operation.title: Dispatch envelope
Operation.description: Per-unit dispatch bounds, ramping and unit commitment. Ramp rates are fractions of installed capacity PER HOUR; frameworks constraining per timestep receive value * hours-per-timestep. Commitment fields beyond min stable load are honored where the target supports them (Calliope 0.7 base math has no start-up/min-up-time formulation).

max_pu.description: Maximum output per unit of capacity (fraction; renewable feed-in profiles go here).

x-map.adopt-net0: RES profile from ClimateData / generic production

min_pu.description: Minimum output per unit of capacity (fraction). > 0 without committable is a must-run condition.

equals_pu.description: fixed dispatch per unit of capacity (non-curtailable resource); overrides max_pu/min_pu.
equals_pu.x-go: Operation.EqualsPU (pypsa p_min_pu = p_max_pu; calliope source_use_equals; rejected by adopt-net0)

ramp_up.description: Maximum upward change (fraction of capacity per hour). Accepts the Value shapes; every target renders ramps as scalars today (series are rejected).

x-map.adopt-net0: ramping_rate (absolute; converted via size and resolution)

ramp_down.description: Maximum downward change (fraction of capacity per hour). Same scalar-only note as ramp_up.

min_uptime.description: Minimum consecutive on-time (hours; converted to timesteps by emitters).

min_downtime.description: Minimum consecutive off-time (hours; converted to timesteps by emitters).

max_startups.description: maximum number of start-ups over the horizon.

standby_power.description: consumption while committed but idle, fraction of capacity.

x-map.pypsa: stand_by_cost prices the idle state (energy standby needs native)

Storage.title: Storage specification
Storage.description: State-of-charge behaviour of a storage technology. The technology's `capacity` bounds charge/discharge POWER (MW); `energy_capacity` bounds stored ENERGY (MWh). Setting max_hours couples the two at a fixed ratio (PyPSA StorageUnit / AdOpT fixedratio); leaving it unset with an expandable energy_capacity optimizes them independently (PyPSA Store + links / AdOpT flexratio / Calliope default).

energy_capacity.description: Stored-energy capacity bounds (MWh). Its investment cost is CostClass.investment_per_energy_capacity.

max_hours.description: Fixed energy-to-power ratio in hours: energy capacity = max_hours * power capacity.

max_charge_rate.description: maximum charging power as a fraction of energy capacity per hour (independent power/energy sizing).

x-map.pypsa: charger link p_nom_max relative to e_nom

max_discharge_rate.description: maximum discharging power as a fraction of energy capacity per hour.

x-map.pypsa: discharger link p_nom_max relative to e_nom

self_discharge.description: Self-discharge per hour as a fraction of the state of charge.

depth_of_discharge.description: minimum state of charge as a fraction of energy capacity.

inflow.description: Exogenous inflow into the storage (MW), e.g. hydro reservoir inflow (scalar or series).

spill_cost.description: Cost per MWh of spilled inflow.

initial_soc.description: State of charge at the first timestep as a fraction of energy capacity; omitted = optimizer's choice (subject to `cyclic`).

cyclic.description: Force the final state of charge to equal the initial one.

no_simultaneous_charge_discharge.description: forbid charging and discharging in the same timestep (binary formulation).

allOf.$comment: max_hours (fixed power/energy ratio) and independent rate bounds are mutually exclusive (Go validateStorage).

CostClass.title: Cost class
CostClass.description: Costs of a component within one cost class (map key on the parent; 'monetary' is what every emitter reads). Investment figures follow the technology's cost_basis (overnight vs annualized). fixed_om and fixed_om_fraction are mutually exclusive conventions.

investment_per_capacity.description: Investment cost per unit of (power) capacity (currency/MW; basis per cost_basis).

investment_per_energy_capacity.description: Investment cost per unit of storage ENERGY capacity (currency/MWh).

x-map.pypsa: stores capital_cost / storage_units capital_cost via max_hours

investment_per_capacity_distance.description: Transmission-only: investment cost per unit capacity AND km (currency/MW/km).

x-map.pypsa: folded into capital_cost as value * length

fixed_om.description: Fixed O&M per unit of installed capacity and year (currency/MW/a).

fixed_om_fraction.description: fixed annual O&M as a fraction of upfront investment (AdOpT-NET0's native convention). Mutually exclusive with fixed_om.
fixed_om_fraction.x-go: CostClass.FixedOMFraction (adopt-net0 OPEX_fixed; calliope cost_om_annual_investment_fraction; pypsa folds into capital_cost)

variable_om.description: Variable operating cost per MWh of reference output (scalar or series).

fuel_cost.description: cost per MWh of carrier INPUT, distinct from variable_om on output.
fuel_cost.x-go: CostClass.FuelCost (calliope cost_flow_in; pypsa folds fuel/efficiency into marginal_cost; rejected by adopt-net0)

x-map.adopt-net0: import price of the input carrier
x-map.pypsa: folded into marginal_cost as fuel_cost / efficiency

purchase.description: Fixed lump-sum cost incurred once when any capacity is built (currency); introduces a binary.

Transmission.title: Transmission link
Transmission.description: Moves one carrier between two nodes.

bidirectional.description: Whether flow may go both ways over the same capacity.

capacity.description: Transport capacity of the arc (MW of carrier flow).

efficiency.description: Distance-independent transport efficiency (fraction delivered per unit sent). Accepts the Value shapes; every target renders it as a scalar today (series are rejected).

x-map.adopt-net0: folded into Performance.loss over the distance

distance.description: Arc length in km (drives per-distance costs and losses); derived from node coords when omitted.

costs.description: Costs per cost class; distance-proportional investment goes into investment_per_capacity_distance.

loss_per_distance.description: transport loss per km as a fraction of flow. Composition differs per framework (adopt-net0 linear 1 - loss*distance, calliope multiplicative eff^distance); emitters match the total arc loss.

x-map.pypsa: folded into efficiency as (1 - loss_per_distance * length)

min_flow.description: minimum flow while the arc is used, fraction of arc capacity.

emission_factor.description: emissions per MWh transported (t CO2-eq/MWh); leakage-loss emissions (loss2emissions) stay native.
emission_factor.x-go: Transmission.EmissionFactor (calliope co2 cost class on the link flow; rejected elsewhere)

x-map.pypsa: co2_emissions on a dedicated link carrier
x-map.calliope: co2 cost class on the link tech

energy_consumption.description: auxiliary energy consumed by transporting (e.g. compressor electricity), linear model. The thermodynamic compressor model (adopt-net0 cons_model 2) stays native.

per_flow_distance.description: Consumption per MWh transported and km.

energy_consumption.x-go: Transmission.EnergyConsumption (pypsa multi-port link, one-way arcs only; rejected elsewhere)

active.description: Deactivate the arc without deleting it.

Trade.title: Market trade
Trade.description: Import/export of a carrier at a node against an external market.

import.description: Purchases from outside into the node (price = cost per MWh).

export.description: Sales from the node to outside (price = revenue per MWh).

limit.description: Maximum exchanged power per timestep (MW), scalar or series (pypsa: fixed-p_nom generator with time-varying p_max_pu/p_min_pu; adopt-net0: per-timestep limit column; calliope: scalar only, series rejected).

x-map.pypsa: p_nom (or p_max_pu series) of the boundary component
x-map.calliope: flow_cap_max / source_use_max of the boundary tech
cost_flow_out / cost_flow_in of the boundary tech

emission_factor.description: Emissions attributed per MWh exchanged (t CO2-eq/MWh), on either side (adopt-net0: Import/Export emission factor columns; calliope: co2 cost class on the market techs; pypsa: warns, set the carrier's co2_intensity instead).

x-map.calliope: co2 cost class on the boundary tech

limit.description: Right-hand side (t CO2-eq over the weighted horizon).

period.description: Investment period the cap applies to; omitted = whole horizon.

x-map.calliope: cost_max on a cost class / custom math

Constraint.title: Portable linear constraint
Constraint.description: sum_i(coefficient_i * variable_i[scope_i]) sense bound. Rendered natively per target (PyPSA GlobalConstraint / extra_functionality, Calliope custom math, AdOpT constraints). Nonlinear constraints stay in native. Typed shortcuts of the first-revision schema (capacity/transmission expansion limits) are expressed as terms over the `capacity` variable; length-weighted transmission volume limits are not expressible and stay native.

period.description: Investment period the constraint applies to (optional).

variable.description: Summed canonical quantity: installed capacity (flow_cap / p_nom), dispatched output, consumed input, storage energy capacity, or emitted quantity of a carrier.

techs.description: Scope: tech ids (empty = all in scope).

Experiment.title: Experiment (run specification)
Experiment.description: Everything about HOW to solve, kept separate from WHAT the physical system is. The typed per-mode blocks (operate/alternatives/pareto/monte_carlo) replace the legacy solver.options namespaces; emitters honor the legacy keys with first-class fields winning, and ValidateFor emits deprecation warnings.

mode.description: plan: single cost-optimal capacity+dispatch. operate: fixed capacities, receding-horizon dispatch. alternatives: near-optimal alternatives (SPORES/MGA). pareto: multi-objective front. monte_carlo: parametric uncertainty sampling. stochastic: scenario-weighted stochastic program. Per-target support is declared in the capability matrix (operate/alternatives -> Calliope, pareto/monte_carlo -> AdOpT-NET0, stochastic -> PyPSA; a sweep is N plan runs orchestrated by the service).

objective.description: System objective. A cost objective under an emission cap is min_cost plus a model.emission_limits entry (the cap is a constraint, not an objective). min_emissions is capability-gated (currently AdOpT-only).

emission_accounting.description: whether emission objectives/caps count net emissions (positive minus captured) or positive emissions only.

method.description: typical_days: k-means/TSAM typical-day clustering (AdOpT native). resample: coarsen resolution (Calliope native). cluster: map each date to a representative date given by cluster_series (accepted by the model; no target claims it yet - every target rejects it).
method.x-go: TimeAggregation.Method (typical_days | resample | cluster; no target claims cluster yet)

resolution.description: Target resolution as a pandas frequency alias (method resample), e.g. "3H".

cluster_series.description: series mapping each date to its representative date (method cluster).

keep_full_resolution_for.description: technology ids or classes kept at full temporal resolution during typical-day clustering (should include all storage).

operate.description: Rolling-horizon settings for mode 'operate'. First-class replacement for the deprecated solver.options.operate namespace (first-class wins; Calliope emitter defaults: window 12h, horizon 24h; the PyPSA runner consumes the horizon as whole hours).

alternatives.description: Near-optimal-alternatives settings for mode 'alternatives' (Calliope SPORES / PyPSA MGA). First-class replacement for the deprecated solver.options.spores/mga namespaces.

slack.description: Allowed cost slack over the baseline optimum (fraction).

pareto.description: Multi-objective front settings for mode 'pareto'. First-class replacement for the deprecated solver.options.pareto namespace (emitter default 5 points).

monte_carlo.description: Sampling settings for mode 'monte_carlo'. First-class replacement for the deprecated solver.options.monte_carlo namespace (emitter default 10 samples).

standard_deviation.description: Relative standard deviation of the sampled parameters (normal distribution).

scenarios.description: Branches of a stochastic run (or members of an ensemble). Override values are numbers everywhere; strings/booleans are accepted for deterministic expansion and rejected by the pypsa stochastic runner.

x-map.adopt-net0: one emitted case folder per scenario

sweep.description: Parameter-sweep axes the orchestrator expands into the cartesian product of independent runs.

solver.description: Solver selection. time_limit/mip_gap/threads are first-class and mapped onto each target's convention (AdOpT-NET0 solveroptions; linopy/pyomo option names per solver, with a warning for unmapped solvers). Options remains the free-form passthrough; the legacy operate/spores/mga/pareto/monte_carlo namespaces inside it are deprecated (ValidateFor warns).

name.description: Solver name. Support differs: adopt-net0 accepts gurobi/gurobi_persistent/glpk; calliope any Pyomo solver; pypsa any linopy solver.

time_limit.description: Wall-clock limit in SECONDS (adopt-net0 timelim configures hours: value / 3600; pypsa/calliope map onto the selected solver's option names).

custom_math.description: Calliope only: whether portable `constraints` and `emission_limits` are rendered into a Calliope 0.7 add_math file. Omitted or true renders them (default); false leaves them in the JSON sidecar.

allow_unmet_demand.description: allow the energy balance to be violated at a penalty price instead of making the model infeasible.

penalty_price.description: Cost per MWh of violated balance.

allow_unmet_demand.x-go: Experiment.AllowUnmetDemand (adopt-net0 energybalance.violation; calliope ensure_feasibility with bigM penalty; rejected by pypsa)

copperplate.description: ignore all inter-node transport constraints (single-bus equivalent; the AdOpT emitter currently hardcodes 0).

reporting.description: Result reporting where a target has native hooks (output locations stay service-managed).

output_dir.x-go: Reporting.OutputDir (managed by the service layer; warned and ignored)

case_name.description: Case label appended to result folder names.

shadow_prices.description: Constraint groups whose duals should be reported.

native.description: Target-specific run configuration (solver heuristics, scaling, reporting details).

weight.description: Probability weight (mode stochastic; normalized by emitters).

overrides.description: Dotted parameter path -> value, applied over the base model (same addressing as sweep.parameter). Numeric values everywhere; string/boolean values are accepted for deterministic expansion and rejected by the pypsa stochastic runner.
overrides.x-go: Scenario.Overrides map[string]any (pypsa stochastic requires numeric values)
